subject: Logic
title: Decide and Learn
description: A micro-lesson that makes Decide and Learn usable.

hook.text: You agonized for weeks, chose perfectly—and the world changed the next day. Perfect planning met imperfect reality.

buildup.text: In complex systems, the feedback from a quick decision often teaches more than extended analysis could.

discovery.text: This is the explore-exploit tradeoff: sometimes acting fast and adjusting beats waiting for certainty.

twist.text: Perfectionism in decisions is itself a decision—to spend time instead of learning from action.

climax.text: Make fast, reversible decisions. Learn from the outcome. Adjust. Repeat. Speed beats precision in volatile environments.

punchline.text: Done, learned, adjusted beats perfect but late.

quiz.question: When is deciding quickly better than thorough analysis?
options: When decisions are reversible and environments are volatile
